name: ai-ecosystem-video
description: Short promo video of the AI Ecosystem Graph, made with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render Promo out/raw-square.mp4 --scale=2 --crf=12 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw-square.mp4 -vf scale=1080:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 15 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/ai-ecosystem-square.mp4
scripts.render:wide: remotion render PromoWide out/raw-wide.mp4 --scale=2 --crf=12 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw-wide.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 15 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/ai-ecosystem-wide.mp4
